items.title: Fishing quota talks resume with a shared ledger on the table
items.summary: Twelve coastal states are meeting for what organisers hope is the final round.

items.title: Freight rates climb as holiday shipping peaks
items.summary: Shippers are paying more for space on routes into Port Calder, where volumes are running well ahead of last year.

items.title: First hard frost arrives two weeks early
items.summary: The weather station on the ridge recorded minus four degrees before dawn on Sunday.

items.title: Northgate Bridge repairs enter their final phase as crews pour the new deck
items.summary: The pour is the last major step before inspection; the city still targets a December reopening.

items.title: Library proposes Sunday hours at the Eastbank branch
items.summary: The board will vote on Wednesday on a plan to shift two weekday evening hours to Sunday afternoons.

items.title: Hold council meetings after work, not at 3 p.m.
items.summary: Afternoon sessions shut out the residents most affected by the decisions being made.
items.stance: Evening meetings would open city hall to working residents.
